mapper.select: select bt.id, bt.tenant_id, bt.username, bt.tenant_name, bt.tenant_short_name, bt.tenant_logo, bt.industry, bt.status, bt.business_desc, bt.contact_person, bt.contact_phone, bt.contact_email, bt.contact_address, bt.package_id, (select btp.name from bedrock_tenant_package btp where btp.id = bt.package_id) as package_name, bt.db_instance_id, bt.tenant_domain, bt.max_user_num, bt.expire_time, bt.remark, bt.ext_config from bedrock_tenant bt where bt.id = #{id}

select bt.id, bt.tenant_id, bt.username, bt.tenant_name, bt.tenant_short_name, bt.tenant_logo, bt.industry, bt.status, bt.business_desc, bt.contact_person, bt.contact_phone, bt.contact_email, bt.contact_address, bt.package_id, (select btp.name from bedrock_tenant_package btp where btp.id = bt.package_id) as package_name, bt.db_instance_id, bt.tenant_domain, bt.max_user_num, bt.expire_time, bt.remark, bt.ext_config from bedrock_tenant bt where bt.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
